about: Corrections to the film feed (tools/catalog/build_feed.py), applied by the next weekly build. 'include': IMDb ids always in the feed, for films the sources miss (Cinemeta lists three genres at most, and for Alien none of them is horror). 'exclude': IMDb ids kept out of the feed altogether. 'notInRow': for a row's id, IMDb ids kept out of that row only. The names beside the ids are for people; only the ids are read.
includeNames: Alien; Aliens; The Substance; The Nun (2018); House of Wax (2005); Abigail (2024); The Girl with All the Gifts; Troll Hunter; Sea Fever; Thelma; The Frighteners; Only Lovers Left Alive; The Tenant; Beetlejuice; Four Flies on Grey Velvet; A Lizard in a Woman's Skin; Cannon Fodder; Children of the Fall; Cats on a Pedal Boat
notInRowNames: slashers: Mindhunters; zombies: The Cabin in the Woods
